Risk: Capital spend is committed without authorisation
Control Description: The Finance Controller approves each request before a purchase order is issued.
Test Procedure: For a sample of capital purchase orders, inspect the capex request for Finance Controller approval dated before the purchase order date.

Risk: Assets are bought at uncompetitive prices or from unvetted vendors
Control Description: The Procurement team issues the purchase order only after three vendor quotations have been compared.
Test Procedure: For a sample of capital purchase orders above the threshold, inspect the comparison of three quotations and confirm it is dated before the purchase order.

Risk: Assets received differ from what was ordered, or are incomplete
Control Description: The Stores team receives the asset and checks the delivery against the purchase order.
Test Procedure: For a sample of goods receipt notes, agree description and quantity to the purchase order and inspect evidence of the Stores team check.

Risk: Payment is released for assets not received or at incorrect amounts
Control Description: The Accounts Payable team performs a three-way match of purchase order, goods receipt and vendor invoice before payment is released.
Test Procedure: Re-perform the three-way match for a sample of capital invoices and confirm that no payment was released with an unresolved mismatch.

Risk: Depreciation errors are not detected before posting
Control Description: The Finance Controller reviews the depreciation run each month-end and signs off the journal.
Test Procedure: For a sample of months, inspect the depreciation run and journal for evidence of Finance Controller review and sign-off within the close timeline.

Risk: Recorded assets do not exist or cannot be traced
Control Description: A physical verification of all fixed assets is carried out annually and differences are reconciled to the fixed asset register.
Test Procedure: Inspect the latest physical verification report, test-count a sample from register to floor and floor to register, and confirm differences were reconciled and adjusted.

Risk: Assets are disposed of or removed without authorisation
Control Description: Asset disposals are approved by the Plant Head before the asset is removed from the register.
Test Procedure: For a sample of disposals, inspect Plant Head approval dated before the removal entry in the fixed asset register.

Risk: Fixed asset balances in the sub-ledger and general ledger do not agree
Control Description: The fixed asset sub-ledger is reconciled to the general ledger every month-end.
Test Procedure: For a sample of months, inspect the reconciliation, agree balances to the ledger and sub-ledger, and confirm reconciling items are cleared.

Risk: Depreciation is calculated using incorrect useful lives
Control Description: Depreciation is calculated by the ERP system using the useful lives set in the asset master.
Test Procedure: Agree useful lives in the asset master to the depreciation policy and recompute depreciation for a sample of assets against the ERP depreciation run.
